TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_SELECT_SRC
(
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				[FILE_NAME],
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				[BANK_ID] ,
				convert(numeric(20,0),ISNULL([CATEGORYID],0),0) AS CATEGORYID ,
				[CATEGORYTYPE] ,
				[VALUE] ,
				[DESCRIPTION] ,
				[DEL_FLG],
				[FILE_NAME], 
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_CRM_CATEGORIES]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_SELECT_SRC
(
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				[FILE_NAME], 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				[FILE_NAME],
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CRM_CATEGORIES_TEST CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_GROUP_SRC
(
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				[FILE_NAME], 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 	[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_CRM_CATEGORIES]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_CATEGORIES_TEST A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_GROUP_SRC B ON A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
AND COALESCE(A.CATEGORYID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CATEGORYID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CATEGORYTYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CATEGORYTYPE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.VALUE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.VALUE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.DESCRIPTION,'-1') = COALESCE(B.DESCRIPTION,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.DEL_FLG,'-1') = COALESCE(B.DEL_FLG,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1




INSERT INTO EDS.CRM_CATEGORIES_TEST
(
				[BANK_ID],
				[CATEGORYID],
				[CATEGORYTYPE],
				[VALUE],
				[DESCRIPTION],
				[DEL_FLG], 
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				SRC.[BANK_ID],
				SRC.[CATEGORYID],
				SRC.[CATEGORYTYPE],
				SRC.[VALUE],
				SRC.[DESCRIPTION],
				SRC.[DEL_FLG], 
				SRC.FILE_DATE,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.BANK_ID,
				'CRM',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1

select * from EDS.CRM_CATEGORIES_TEST
